traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for docs/stories/010.3-DEV-MIGRATE-TO-SUPPORTS.story.md are fully implemented. The core migration rule is implemented in src/rules/prefer-implements-annotation.ts, wired so that 'traceability/prefer-supports-annotation' is the primary rule name with 'traceability/prefer-implements-annotation' as a deprecated alias. The rule is disabled by default and strictly opt-in via ESLint severity. It detects simple legacy @story + @req blocks, emits configurable recommendation diagnostics, and provides conservative auto-fixes that replace @story/@req lines with a single @supports line while preserving comment formatting and order. Multi-story and mixed @story/@req/@supports patterns are detected and reported as non-fixable, with clear messages. Legacy @story/@req annotations remain valid and unaffected when the rule is disabled, and auto-fix output conforms to the existing @supports validation rules. Documentation (rule doc, migration guide, and API reference) clearly describes the rule, its alias, configuration options, and auto-fix examples. All relevant unit and integration tests for this story pass, confirming behavior and configuration semantics.
